styles.name: mandala
styles.description: Lotus mandala: a ringed six-petal lotus turns slowly at the centre while a border of rosettes and diamonds unrolls symmetrically outward as progress rises.

styles.name: celtic-knot
styles.description: Celtic interlace: two outlined ribbons twist between border rules, each passing over then under the other — the lower ribbon breaks at every crossing; the knotwork extends rightward as progress rises and slowly flows with time.

styles.name: aztec-fret
styles.description: Aztec/Maya stepped fret (xicalcoliuhqui): bold staircase-and-spiral units, alternately mirrored, are laid between border bands from left to right as progress rises; a glint of light sweeps across the finished stone.

styles.name: islamic-star
styles.description: Islamic geometric: eight-pointed interlaced stars ({8/3} star polygons around a ring) bloom into place one after another along a linked chain as progress rises; the rings breathe and the stars glimmer with time.

styles.name: greek-key
styles.description: Greek key / meander: one unbroken squared line climbs and spirals inward again and again between two border rules; it is drawn in from the left as progress rises and slowly travels along the band with time.

styles.name: seigaiha
styles.description: Japanese seigaiha (blue ocean waves): fans of concentric arcs overlap like fish scales, each row tucked behind the one below; scales are laid in from the left as progress rises and the sea drifts gently with time.

styles.name: totem-pole
styles.description: Totem poles: a row of carved poles — stacked faces with hollow eyes, crowned by a thunderbird or a bear — rises one by one from the ground as progress climbs; the thunderbirds beat their wings with time.

styles.name: runes
styles.description: Norse Elder Futhark runes: angular rune-staves are chiselled stroke by stroke into a stone band, in futhark order, as progress rises; sparks flicker at the chisel point.

styles.name: paisley-swirl
styles.description: Paisley (boteh): teardrop motifs with a curled tip and an inner eye are traced one after another, alternately mirrored, as progress rises; each sways gently on its base with time.

styles.name: kente-weave
styles.description: Kente cloth: narrow strips of gold, green and red blocks — weft bars, warp stripes, checks and solid panels — are woven one by one and laid side by side as progress rises; a shuttle darts across the strip on the loom.

styles.name: paper-lanterns
styles.description: Paper lanterns: round red lanterns with gold caps and tassels hang from a sagging festival string; each glows alight from the bottom up in turn as progress rises, and they sway and flicker with time.
